summary: Read-only: extract every feature from the teacher's Share Page mockup, then map each to backend readiness (wire-existing / build-new / static) to produce a Phase 1 spec.

result.spec:
# Phase 1 Scoping Report — Share Page `/s/[videoId]` Rebuild

**Bottom line up front:** The backend is far more complete than a typical mockup-to-production gap. The AI pipeline (chapters, summary, topics, next-steps, tasks, refined transcript, diarized transcript, RAG chat) is **live**. Most work is **UI assembly**, not backend building. Only **4 features need genuinely new backend** — and 3 of those are small.

---

## ✅ Wire existing — backend already real, just connect the new UI

| Feature | Backend evidence |
|---|---|
| **Full playback control bar** | `media-player.tsx` (media-chrome) — play/pause/seek/volume/time all driven by real `<video>`; source via `/api/playlist` → signed S3. |
| **Chapter-segmented progress bar (hover tooltips)** | `generate-ai.ts` → `videos.metadata.chapters`; `GET /api/video/ai`; rendered + click-to-seek in `SegmentedProgressBar.tsx`. End-to-end live. |
| **Click-to-seek chapter timeline (Summary > Timeline)** | `aiSummary.chapters[{startSec,title,body}]`; `SummaryPanel.tsx` calls `onVideoJump`; wired in `ShareVideo.tsx:506`. |
| **Below-video tab bar (Summary/Tasks/Transcript/Refined)** | `BelowVideoTabs.tsx` + all 4 panels wired (`ShareVideo.tsx:503-536`). Pure client switch. |
| **Overview lead card** | `aiSummary.overview` (Gemini) rendered in `SummaryPanel.tsx:44`. Only restyle needed. |
| **Agreed next-steps checklist** | `aiSummary.nextSteps[]` rendered as numbered list `SummaryPanel.tsx:108`. Only restyle. |
| **Transcript entries (speaker/timestamp/text)** | Gemini diarization → VTT → `getTranscript` → `TranscriptPanel.tsx`. Full pipeline live. |
| **Click-to-seek transcript playback (karaoke sync)** | `TranscriptPanel.tsx:152` active-cue highlight + auto-scroll + `onVideoJump`. Fully wired. |
| **Refined-section jump-to-video buttons** | `RefinedTranscriptPanel.tsx:39` play button → `onVideoJump(chapter.startSec)`. Live. |
| **Floating AI orb (FAB)** | `AIFab.tsx` fully built + wired (`ShareVideo.tsx:539`). |
| **AI chat popup (context-aware)** | `POST /api/video/ai/chat` — real Gemini + transcript RAG (`transcript-retrieve.ts`), SSE streaming. **No canned replies in code** (inventory's fear is outdated). |
| **AI suggested-prompt chips** | `AIChatPopup.tsx:28` QUICK_ACTIONS → same real chat endpoint. |
| **AI panel resize handle** | `AIChatPopup.tsx:383` pointer-event resize. Client-only, done. |
| **Comments panel + empty state** | `page.tsx:679` server query joins `comments`+`users`; `EmptyState.tsx`/`Comments.tsx`. |
| **Comment composer** | `actions/videos/new-comment.ts` server action (insert + auth + disableComments check). Fully wired. |
| **Share header with copy-link** | `ShareHeader.tsx:207-273` builds URL + `navigator.clipboard`. (Inventory's "no JS yet" is wrong.) |
| **Author / sharing meta row** | `ShareHeader.tsx:566` owner avatar/name/relative-time + Shared badge → `SharingDialog`. |
| **Owner action buttons** | `ShareHeader.tsx:598` Edit/Analytics/Dashboard, owner-gated, all routes exist. |

---

## 🔨 Build new backend — no backend exists yet

| Feature | What to build (concise) |
|---|---|
| **Task completion persistence** (checkboxes + progress ring) | Create `apps/web/app/api/video/tasks/toggle/route.ts`: accept `{videoId, taskIndex, done}`, authenticate, load `videos.metadata`, set `aiSummary.tasks[i].done`, save. Frontend debounce/optimistic UI **already calls** this dead route (`TasksPanel.tsx:112`). **Small.** |
| **Live customization Tweaks panel** | The referenced `tweaks-panel.jsx` does not exist. Build a client `TweaksPanel` that writes `data-accent/data-motion/data-sticky/data-summary/data-tasks` to `documentElement` + persists to localStorage. (Production: optional `PUT /api/video/preferences`.) Mostly client; "backend" only if persisting server-side. |
| **Summary view switcher (Cards/Timeline/Document)** | **No backend change** — all 3 views consume existing `aiSummary`. Build view-mode state + 3 render branches in `SummaryPanel`. (Listed here only because zero switcher code exists today.) |
| **Document view (bulleted lists + copy/export)** | **No data API needed** — uses existing `topics[]`/`nextSteps[]`. Build the Document render branch + client `navigator.clipboard` copy. Server PDF export only if explicitly required. |

> Note: the last two are "build-new UI on existing data" — no real backend work. Only the **tasks/toggle route** is a true new backend endpoint, and it's tiny.

---

## 🟡 Partial — exists but incomplete

| Feature | What's missing |
|---|---|
| **Sticky video player + thumbnail overlay** | Video URL + S3 poster (`/api/video/og`) + preview GIF (`/api/video/preview`) all exist, but `VideoPreviewGif.tsx` is a **stub returning null** (poster never renders), and **no sticky/scroll-pinning** anywhere. Wire the GIF/poster fetch + add `position:sticky`/IntersectionObserver + localStorage flag. No new API. |
| **Secondary controls (captions/settings/PiP/fullscreen)** | Captions, PiP, Fullscreen, **playback-speed** all fully wired. Missing: **quality selection** needs an HLS manifest (multi-bitrate transcode → `.m3u8`) — current MP4 never populates `mediaRenditionList`. **Caption translation** needs a translation job storing translated VTTs in S3. Core controls ship today; quality + translation are separate backend jobs. |
| **Summary stat strip** | Duration / topic-count / task-count derivable from existing metadata. **Participant count has NO backend** — `speakerCount` hardcoded `undefined`. Build: extract distinct speakers from `transcriptions.speaker` column (or preserve VTT speaker tags) → expose via page data. |
| **Key-topics grid (Cards)** | `topics[{title,body}]` exist + grid renders, but **no icon/category field**. Extend Gemini prompt + `AiSummarySchema` + type with an icon/category key; add icon slot to card. |
| **Tasks progress header** | Renders from in-memory state correctly; counts **don't survive reload** — blocked on the same `tasks/toggle` route above. |
| **Tasks Board/Checklist switch** | `TasksPanel` reads `data-tasks` + MutationObserver, but **nothing writes it** and no localStorage. Build the segmented toggle (client-only). |
| **Grouped task cards (assignee/priority/deadline)** | AI extracts `{title,assignee,priority,deadline,done}` + cards render, but **no `category`/group field** (checklist groups by priority only) and **no participant directory** for real avatars. Add `category` to schema+prompt; optional `participants[]` for avatars. |
| **Refined transcript report** | `refinedTranscript.chapters[{startSec,title,paragraphs}]` fully generated + rendered, but the **report header (participants, duration, purpose) does not exist**. Add `reportHeader` to schema + prompt + `/api/video/ai` response; render header block. |
| **Engagement analytics row** | Views (Tinybird), comment/reaction counts all available, but **gated to owners/members only** — public viewers never see it. Relax `isOwnerOrMember` guard; no new endpoint. |
| **Quick emoji reactions** | Clicking inserts a `comments` row (`type='emoji'`), but **no toggle/dedup, no per-user tracking, no delete** — same user can spam unlimited reactions. Build dedup: check existing reaction, DELETE on un-react, expose `userReacted` flag. |
| **Reduced-motion / animations toggle** | OS `prefers-reduced-motion` respected in 2 spots, but **no user-toggled `data-motion` override**. Add toggle + global `[data-motion='reduced'] *{animation:none}` CSS + localStorage. |

---

## ⚠️ Risk: pretty-but-dead UI

These ship convincingly as fake if not deliberately wired. **Watch list:**

1. **Task checkboxes / progress ring** — HIGHEST RISK. UI is fully animated and *calls a route that doesn't exist*. Toggling looks perfect, then resets on reload. **Must wire to `POST /api/video/tasks/toggle` (build it).**
2. **Emoji reactions** — counts "always increment to 1 locally." Will look interactive but is non-persistent/spammable. **Must wire to dedup + persisted reaction state.**
3. **Summary stat strip → participant count** — three of four cards are real; "participants: 2" will be **hardcoded fake** unless wired to `transcriptions.speaker`.
4. **Key-topic icons** — easy to drop in static/random icons. **Must come from an AI category field**, else decorative noise.
5. **Quality selector (settings gear)** — renders an empty/inert menu on MP4. **Either wire to real HLS renditions or hide it** — don't show a dead dropdown.
6. **Caption language switcher** — same trap: a language list with no translated VTTs behind it. **Hide until translation backend exists.**
7. **Refined report header** — participants/duration/purpose will be **placeholder text** unless `reportHeader` is generated.
8. **Sticky-video + thumbnail overlay** — `VideoPreviewGif` returns null today; the poster/play-overlay is the *first thing users see* and currently renders nothing real.
9. **Tweaks panel** — references a missing file + external CDN React. If shipped as-is it's a demo artifact, not product. **Decide: ship as real localStorage tool, or cut from Phase 1.**

---

## Honest verdict

**Yes — the teacher's design can be made fully FUNCTIONAL, not faked.** The hard part (the entire AI analysis + transcription + RAG-chat pipeline) is already real and serving data. There is **no feature that is impossible** within Phase 1; the only items requiring meaningful *infrastructure* (HLS transcode for quality, VTT translation jobs) are isolated and can be **deferred or hidden** without breaking the page.

**Effort split (32 features):**

- **~17 wire-existing (~55%)** — pure UI assembly against live data/components. Low risk, fast.
- **~11 partial (~34%)** — UI mostly exists; each needs a small, well-scoped backend or wiring fix (schema field + prompt line, a guard removal, a dedup branch, a stub fill).
- **~4 build-new (~12%)** — and of these, only **one is a true new endpoint** (`tasks/toggle`, tiny); the other three are new UI on *existing* data.

**Real backend work is small and concentrated:**
1. `POST /api/video/tasks/toggle` (new route) — **the single most important build; unblocks 2 features.**
2. Schema+prompt additions (additive, one Gemini pass): topic `icon/category`, task `category`, refined `reportHeader`, `participants[]`.
3. `speakerCount` extraction from `transcriptions.speaker`.
4. Emoji reaction dedup/delete.
5. Relax analytics-row visibility guard.

**Defer/hide cleanly (avoid dead UI):** HLS quality renditions, caption translation. **Decide scope:** Tweaks panel (real tool vs cut).

**Recommendation:** Phase 1 is dominated by front-end assembly. Delegate the wire-existing batch in parallel by panel ownership (Summary / Tasks / Transcript / Refined / Comments / Header / Player). The backend track is one engineer doing the `tasks/toggle` route + the additive AI-schema fields. Build the `tasks/toggle` route **first** so the tasks panel is never a fake.

---

Key files: `apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/ShareVideo.tsx` (wiring hub), `apps/web/workflows/generate-ai.ts` (AI schema/prompt — additive edits land here), `apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/panels/*` (panel UIs), `apps/web/app/api/video/tasks/toggle/route.ts` (**to create**), `packages/database/types/metadata.ts` (AiSummary type — additive fields).

items.feature: Sticky video player with thumbnail + play overlay
items.evidence: Real video URL exists via /api/playlist (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/ShareVideo.tsx:344). Poster/thumbnail image exists in S3 at screenshot/screen-capture.jpg served by /api/video/og (apps/web/actions/videos/get-og-image.tsx:64) and animated preview GIF via /api/video/preview (apps/web/app/api/video/preview/route.ts). Play button overlay is real and wired to videoRef.current.play() (CapVideoPlayer.tsx:794). However: (1) VideoPreviewGif component is a stub returning null (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/VideoPreviewGif.tsx:11) so the thumbnail overlay is never rendered from S3; (2) no sticky/scroll-pinning behavior exists anywhere in the player wrapper — no scroll listener, no position:sticky on the video container, no user preference flag for it.
items.whatToBuild: Wire VideoPreviewGif to actually fetch /api/video/preview (falling back to /api/video/og) and render the poster image with a play button overlay until first play. Add a scroll IntersectionObserver (or position:sticky CSS) on the player container div in ShareVideo.tsx to pin it to the top of the viewport on scroll, toggled by a user preference stored in localStorage (matching the Tweaks panel pattern). No new API routes needed — both the screenshot and preview-gif endpoints already exist.

items.evidence: The entire control bar is wired to a real HTMLVideoElement via the media-chrome library (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/video/media-player.tsx imports from 'media-chrome/react/media-store'). MediaPlayerPlay dispatches MEDIA_PLAY_REQUEST / MEDIA_PAUSE_REQUEST; MediaPlayerSeekBackward and MediaPlayerSeekForward dispatch MEDIA_SEEK_REQUEST with real currentTime math; MediaPlayerVolume binds to MEDIA_VOLUME_REQUEST; MediaPlayerTime reads mediaCurrentTime and mediaDuration from the media store — all driven by the real video element, not fake. Video source resolves to /api/playlist which redirects to a signed S3 URL (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/playback-source.ts:181).
items.whatToBuild: No backend work needed. The control bar just needs to be assembled in the new teacher mockup layout (bottom gradient bar) by composing the existing MediaPlayerPlay, MediaPlayerSeekBackward, MediaPlayerSeekForward, MediaPlayerVolume, and MediaPlayerTime components inside MediaPlayerControls — all already exported from media-player.tsx.

items.feature: Secondary player controls (captions, settings, PiP, fullscreen)
items.evidence: Captions toggle (MediaPlayerCaptions) and subtitle VTT are real: ShareVideo.tsx:188-196 builds a blob URL from transcription data when transcriptionStatus === 'COMPLETE' and passes it as captionsSrc to a <track> element on the video. PiP (MediaPlayerPiP) calls document.exitPictureInPicture() / videoElement.requestPictureInPicture() directly — fully wired browser API, media-player.tsx:3068-3095. Fullscreen (MediaPlayerFullscreen) dispatches MEDIA_ENTER/EXIT_FULLSCREEN_REQUEST via media-chrome — fully wired, media-player.tsx:3018-3050. Settings gear (MediaPlayerSettings) covers Speed (fully wired) and Quality (media-player.tsx:3603-3647) but the quality sub-menu only renders when mediaRenditionList.length > 0, which requires an HLS stream — the current MP4 source never populates this list. Caption language switching in settings is wired to onCaptionLanguageChange which calls CaptionContext.setSelectedLanguage, but the available translated captions list depends on a separate translation pipeline.
items.whatToBuild: Quality selection requires serving the video as an HLS manifest with multiple bitrate renditions (e.g., via MediaConvert or a transcoding step that produces a .m3u8 with 360p/720p/1080p variants) and switching the player src to the HLS URL so media-chrome can populate mediaRenditionList automatically. Caption language translation requires a backend translation job that stores translated VTT files in S3 and returns them via the availableCaptions prop. PiP and Fullscreen need no backend work. The captions toggle itself works today when a transcript exists.

items.feature: Chapter-segmented progress bar with hover tooltips
items.evidence: apps/web/workflows/generate-ai.ts produces chapters:{title,start}[] stored in videos.metadata.chapters; served by GET /api/video/ai (apps/web/app/api/video/ai/route.ts); polled in Share.tsx; mapped start→startSec in ShareVideo.tsx line 424-427; consumed by SegmentedProgressBar (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/video/SegmentedProgressBar.tsx) which already implements proportional segments, hover tooltip with timestamp+title, white scrubber dot, and click-to-seek via MediaActionTypes.MEDIA_SEEK_REQUEST. Full end-to-end pipeline is live.
items.whatToBuild: Nothing — the complete feature already exists and is wired.

items.evidence: AI workflow (apps/web/workflows/generate-ai.ts) generates aiSummary.chapters:[{startSec,title,body}] stored in videos.metadata.aiSummary; SummaryPanel (apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/panels/SummaryPanel.tsx) renders a vertical list of clickable timestamp pills calling onVideoJump(chapter.startSec); ShareVideo.tsx line 506-513 mounts SummaryPanel with data.metadata?.aiSummary and onVideoJump={handleSeek}, which dispatches a real video seek. Full pipeline is live.
items.whatToBuild: Nothing — the complete feature already exists and is wired. The richer per-chapter description field (chapter.body) is also already populated by the AI and rendered in SummaryPanel.

items.feature: Summary stat strip: duration, participant count, key-topic count, task count
items.evidence: packages/database/schema.ts:359 — videos.duration (float, seconds) exists and is passed to SummaryPanel via data.duration. aiSummary.topics[] and aiSummary.tasks[] exist in metadata (packages/database/types/metadata.ts), so topic and task counts are derivable client-side. However, speaker/participant count has NO backend: apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/ShareVideo.tsx:510 hardcodes speakerCount: undefined, and no speaker extraction exists anywhere in the codebase.
items.whatToBuild: No new API needed for duration, topic count, or task count — all are already in metadata. For participant count: either (a) count distinct speaker tags from the transcription VTT (the VTT parser in generate-ai.ts strips speaker labels, so they would need to be preserved), or (b) parse the transcriptions table (schema.ts:1505 has a speaker column). Then expose speakerCount via the video share page data fetch and pass it through VideoData. Finally build the four-card stat strip UI component.

items.feature: Overview lead card: AI-generated meeting overview/abstract
items.evidence: apps/web/workflows/generate-ai.ts:53-55 — AiSummarySchema includes overview: z.string(). packages/database/types/metadata.ts:6 — AiSummary.overview: string. The field is generated by Gemini, saved to videos.metadata.aiSummary.overview, and already rendered in apps/web/app/s/[videoId]/_components/panels/SummaryPanel.tsx:44-50 as a purple card.
